title: I made a free tennis game with Astra and Sonnet
author: JJJI_STUDIO
selftext:
I'm the solo developer behind JJJI STUDIO. This is Retro Club Tennis, a pixel-art tennis game I made in Godot.

Astra handled the design, while Sonnet reviewed the work in parallel and gave feedback. 

The clip shows a full rally from the game. There are eight players, four tournaments, and practice modes for serves and rallies. You can download the full game for free on the App Store and Google Play.

Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jjjistudio.rctennis](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jjjistudio.rctennis)

iOS: [https://apps.apple.com/kr/app/retro-club-tennis/id6829737421](https://apps.apple.com/kr/app/retro-club-tennis/id6829737421)
